newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle seen steady-lower, feeders mixe.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle seen steady-lower, feeders mixe.

text.p: CME live cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.100 cent per lb lower while calls ranged mixed, from 0.200 cent per lb higher to 0.100 lower for feeder cattle, livestock analysts said.
Some carryover support from Wednesday's late rally and stronger technical picture could support live cattle at the start but most analysts look for renewed pressure to develop.

Wholesale boxed beef movement was active but beef prices continued to slip on Wednesday which will keep packer bids for cash cattle down. Cash cattle prices are seen remaining under pressure into next week, they said.
